2694  Ðā ic æt þearfe [gefrægn] þēodcyninges
2695  andlongne eorl ellen cȳðan,
2696  cræft ond cēnðu, swā him gecynde wæs.
2697  Ne hēdde hē þæs heafolan, ac sīo hand gebarn
2698  mōdiges mannes, þǣr hē his mǣges healp,
2699  þæt hē þone nīðgæst nioðor hwēne slōh,
2700  secg on searwum, þæt ðæt sweord gedēaf
2701  fāh ond fǣted, þæt ðæt fȳr ongon
2702  sweðrian syððan. Þā gēn sylf cyning
2703  gewēold his gewitte, wæll-seaxe gebrǣd
2704  biter ond beaduscearp, þæt hē on byrnan wæg;
2705  forwrāt Wedra helm wyrm on middan.
2706  Fēond gefyldan — ferh ellen wræc —,
2707  ond hī hyne þā bēgen ābroten hæfdon,
2708  sibæðelingas; swylc sceolde secg wesan,
2709  þegn æt ðearfe! Þæt ðām þēodne wæs
2710  sīðas[t] sigehwīla sylfes dǣdum,
2711  worlde geweorces. Ðā sīo wund ongon,
2712  þē him se eorðdraca ǣr geworhte,
2713  swelan ond swellan; hē þæt sōna onfand,
2714  þæt him on brēostum bealonīð(e) wēoll
2715  attor on innan. Ðā se æðeling gīong,
2716  þæt hē bī wealle wīshycgende
2717  gesæt on sesse; seah on enta geweorc,
2718  hū ðā stānbogan stapulum fæste
2719  ēce eorðreced innan healde.
2720  Hyne þā mid handa heorodrēorigne,
2721  þēoden mǣrne þegn ungemete till,
2722  winedryhten his wætere gelafede
2723  hilde sædne ond his hel(m) onspēon.
2724  Bīowulf maþelode — hē ofer benne spræc,
2725  wunde wælblēate; wisse hē gearwe,
2726  þæt hē dæghwīla gedrogen hæfde,
2727  eorðan wynn(e); ðā wæs eall sceacen
2728  dōgorgerīmes, dēað ungemete nēah —:
2729  ‘Nū ic suna mīnum syllan wolde
2730  gūðgewǣdu, þǣr mē gifeðe swā
2731  ǣnig yrfeweard æfter wurde
2732  līce gelenge. Ic ðās lēode hēold
2733  fīftig wintra; næs sē folccyning,
2734  ymbesittendra ǣnig ðāra,
2735  þē mec gūðwinum grētan dorste,
2736  egesan ðeôn. Ic on earde bād
2737  mǣlgesceafta, hēold mīn tela,
2738  ne sōhte searonīðas, nē mē swōr fela
2739  āða on unriht. Ic ðæs ealles mæg
2740  feorhbennum sēoc gefēan habban;
2741  forðām mē wītan ne ðearf Waldend fīra
2742  morðọrbealo māga, þonne mīn sceaceð
2743  līf of līce. Nū ðū lungre geong
2744  hord scēawian under hārne stān,
2745  Wīglāf lēofa, nū se wyrm ligeð,
2746  swefeð sāre wund, since berēafod.
2747  Bīo nū on ofoste, þæt ic ǣrwelan,
2748  goldǣht ongite, gearo scēawige
2749  swegle searogimmas, þæt ic ðȳ sēft mæge
2750  æfter māððumwelan mīn ālǣtan
2751  līf ond lēodscipe, þone ic longe hēold.’
